title: Meaning heard preserves respect’s weight

captions.physics: Returning to a request understood anew
captions.emotions: Feeling the significance of respectful approach

meaning: You can return to a request to be heard understood anew and change a familiar answer’s perspective, feeling respect matter without making understanding compulsory agreement.
text: Judgement in the physical position of your Vishuddha appears in returning to a request to be heard now understood differently. The Hanged Man in energy supports readiness to change a familiar answer’s perspective. The Hierophant in emotions brings significance to respectful approach. You can understand that an actual request concerns meaning heard rather than immediate acceptance of a conclusion. An accepted value of attention requires no identical positions for both.

For example, you return to “Hear me”. Previously this sounded like a demand for agreement; now you can name what is understood and clarify remaining difference. **Respect for meaning does not remove your own answer**. Conversation gains significance when a thought has room without compulsory approval. Yet accurately repeating words does not replace a living response. You can understand an argument and remain doubtful; today’s clarification proves neither perfectly expressed requests nor an inability for their tone to hurt.

Difficulty arises if respectful listening becomes a compulsory ritual of correct retelling before every objection. Another perspective becomes scrutiny while your own answer waits. The constructive Hanged Man helps change the angle without forced concession. You can show understanding simply and freely name difference; respect’s weight is not measured by exact reproduction of a formula, while new understanding requires no permanent abandonment of questioning how you are addressed.
